CellCycleCheck.description: Which lineages are made mostly of cycling cells. Null in a run's trust while prep is not loaded.
CellCycleCheck.title: CellCycleCheck

CellCycleInfo.description: How the dataset's cells were scored for cell cycle (Tirosh 2016). Report only.

share_cycling.description: Share of all cells called S or G2M; null when not scored.
share_cycling.title: Share Cycling

CellCycleInfo.title: CellCycleInfo

ClonalScore.description:
One clonal score of a run's lineages (spec 4.3). ``eta`` is against N1; ``p`` is the
largest p over the nulls, the headline.
ClonalScore.title: ClonalScore

ClonalSettings-Input.description: Which obs columns hold the clone labels, the donors and the strata (spec 4.1).
ClonalSettings-Input.title: ClonalSettings

ClonalSettings-Output.description: Which obs columns hold the clone labels, the donors and the strata (spec 4.1).
ClonalSettings-Output.title: ClonalSettings

ClonalSummary.description: Clone sizes over every labelled cell that has a donor, singletons included.
ClonalSummary.title: ClonalSummary

value.description: The cluster label to start from.
value.title: Value

cell_cycle.description: Null while prep is not loaded.

fingerprint.description: A cheap identity of the file, the one runs record; a shared view link names it.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

tree_likeness.description: The share of PAGA edge weight on its spanning tree at the default resolution (check C2). Null while prep is not loaded, or when the cluster graph has no edges.
tree_likeness.title: Tree Likeness

Divergence.description: The pseudotime at which lineages ``a`` and ``b`` stop sharing cells.
Divergence.title: Divergence

components.description: Diffusion views: how many components there are (DC1 to DCn); null otherwise.
components.title: Components

name.description: Diffusion views are dc12 (DC1, DC2) and dc123 (DC1-DC3); /embeddings also serves any two or three different components as dc:i,j or dc:i,j,k.
name.title: Name

source.description: file: read from obsm; computed: made by lumenCell's prep; diffusion: DC components.
source.title: Source

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show in the UI.
message.title: Message

FileRoot.description: Use the root stored in the .h5ad (uns['iroot'] or a boolean obs 'root' column).
FileRoot.title: FileRoot

r2.description: Share of the gene's variance on this lineage that the trend explains.
r2.title: R2

y.description: Smoothed mean per bin; null where the bin has no cells.
y.title: Y

id.description: Leiden cluster code (the categories of lumencell_leiden).
id.title: Id

kind.description: A kind the contract does not list is reported by its own name.
kind.title: Kind

LineageCoupling.description: How much two lineages share clones, against N1. Says nothing about which came first.
LineageCoupling.title: LineageCoupling

fidelity.description: Spearman of pseudotime against position along the drawn curve.
fidelity.title: Fidelity

points.description: Two coordinates per point; three on 3-D views (dc123, dc:i,j,k).
points.title: Points

share_cycling.description: Null when no cell is on this lineage alone.
share_cycling.title: Share Cycling

experimental_note.description: Why the method is experimental, from the benchmark.
experimental_note.title: Experimental Note

params_schema.description: JSON Schema of the method's parameters.
params_schema.title: Params Schema

reference_scores.description: The method's published benchmark results, one row per dataset and gate. These are reference results, not a score for the user's data.
reference_scores.title: Reference Scores

Notice.description: A warning or diagnostic attached to a result. Shown in the trust panel.
Notice.title: Notice

colors.description: One hex colour per category, when the file has them.
colors.title: Colors

PagaGraph.description: PAGA over the Leiden clusters of prep, drawn on an embedding: a picture of the cluster graph.

nodes.description: Each cluster at the mean position of its cells; a cluster with no finite position is left out, with its edges.
nodes.title: Nodes

PagaGraph.title: PagaGraph

dataset.description: The benchmark dataset. Never the user's own data.
dataset.title: Dataset

detail.description: How many cases failed, or why the gate was not measured.
detail.title: Detail

metric.description: What the gate measures, in plain words.
metric.title: Metric

passed.description: Whether the gate passed. Null when not measured.
passed.title: Passed

score.description: The worst case's value (synthetic) or the measured value (real). Null if not measured.
score.title: Score

source.description: The committed result file and commit the row was read from.
source.title: Source

threshold.description: The gate's bound, as declared in bench/policy/thresholds.toml.
threshold.title: Threshold

resolved_by.description: The rule that picked the cell, in words.
resolved_by.title: Resolved By

RootSuggestion.description: A candidate start point. Never applied automatically.

evidence.description: Why this is suggested, e.g. '84% of cells at day 0 (p=1e-40)'.
evidence.title: Evidence

is_extremity.description: Whether the cluster sits at an end of the PAGA graph.
is_extremity.title: Is Extremity

RootSuggestion.title: RootSuggestion

SupportCheck.description: One check of the tree-support verdict (spec 5.3). ``value`` is null when undefined.
SupportCheck.title: SupportCheck

root.description: Omit to use the saved root; 409 if none is saved.
root.title: Root

cell_arrays.description: Names of the arrays served by GET .../cells.
cell_arrays.title: Cell Arrays

trust.description: What the run is checked against. Always filled for a done run; clonal scoring and stability run in the background, so either may be pending.

TreeSupport.description:
How far the run's tree is supported. While the verdict rule has not passed its verification
on fresh seeds, a supported run is shown as provisional, and ``reasons`` says so.
A failed check is shown as weak.
TreeSupport.title: TreeSupport
